title: Steganographic Channel Capacity Test for Hidden CoT Messaging

original_idea.body: # Steganographic Channel Capacity Test. Two colluding model instances encode/decode a secret bit-string while a monitor flags suspicion; measure channel capacity vs detection rate. Release testbed.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying covert CoT channel capacity vs monitors targets the encoded-reasoning safety problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multi-agent encode/decode/monitor prompting; some harness engineering, mentor helps.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused capacity-vs-detection testbed; multiple encoding strategies add breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Self-contained steganography testbed for monitoring; labs deprioritize, third-party value.

novelty.reasoning: Steganography monitoring studied; empirical channel-capacity testbed plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Steganography monitoring studied; empirical capacity-vs-detection testbed plausibly open.
